news.title: ‘I’m going to bomb your house’: Man accused of threatening animal services director
news.summary: A Washington state man was jailed after being accused of threatening to bomb the home of a Metro Atlanta animal services director, according to Cobb County police.

news.title: 2 brothers killed in apartment shooting, police searching for shooter
news.summary: Investigators continue to search for a the shooter who killed two boys outside of their Dekalb County apartment off North Hairston Road. The boys were 11 and 12 years old.

news.title: Woman says musician slapped her during concert, police report filed
news.summary: A woman says she was slapped by a musician during a concert in Tucker earlier this month, an alleged confrontation captured on cellphone video that is now the subject of a police report.

news.title: Young brothers killed in tragic Stone Mountain shooting identified as police search for suspect
news.summary: Family members shared photos of the two brothers with 11Alive. One showed Jamarion wearing a Daffy Duck shirt. Another showed Jahki holding a school certificate.

news.title: Final missing Hurricane Helene victim in Tennessee found

news.title: 2 boys killed, 2 women injured in deadly shooting at Stone Mountain home, police say
news.summary: Police said that 11-year-old and 12-year-old boys were tragically killed in the shooting that stemmed from a disagreement earlier in the day.
